note: Points mode (decisions 2 and 3, 1 Oct 2026): Fee Index markets only, no SOL, no fee, no wallet transaction. Every signed-in wallet gets 100 points each epoch (unused points do not carry over); a call is 10, 25, 50 or 100 points; when the final Fee Index resolves a market, the losing side's points are shared among the winners in proportion to their calls; the leaderboard ranks net points won over the last 30 epochs. Points have no cash value and cannot be bought, sold or transferred. The demo wallet has called 50 of its 100 points in epoch 1044.
payoutFormula: payout = a * (P + a) / (s * P + a)  // a = points called, P = pool in points, s = chosen side share; no fee in points mode
